description.value: You make one of your thralls Crawl, Drop Prone, Escape, Interact, Stand, Stride, or Strike. A thrall can take only simple Interact actions, not ones that require skill checks or complicated movements. However, they can make checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Escape] using your spell attack modifier. Escaping this way uses and counts toward your multiple attack penalty.
